tianxia.talent.fire.white_hot_focus.why: 'The next Fire talent you use this turn gains one: Advantage on one attack roll; one target has Disadvantage on its saving throw; add your Path key ability modifier to one Fire damage roll; ignore Resistance to Fire damage for one target. After the talent resolves, take Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.' (combat/ext/fire_sphere.py, four compiled buttons and the attack_mode/save/attack_damage_bonus/damage_roll_bonus/resistance_ignored readers).
